passages.note: IGA bill-details digest for SB 1(ss) (2022ss1); names the author/sponsors and final actions but never mentions Koch or a vote tally.
Official Senate roll call on final passage of SB 1(ss) (2022ss1); Koch is listed among the Yea votes.

passages.provision_quote: before the earlier of viability of the fetus or twenty (20) weeks of postfertilization age of the fetus, if: (A) for reasons based upon the professional, medical judgment of the pregnant woman's physician, if either: (i) the abortion is necessary when reasonable medical judgment dictates that performing the abortion is necessary to prevent any serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save the pregnant woman's life; or (ii) the fetus is diagnosed with a lethal fetal anomaly;
passages.note: Enrolled bill text amending IC 16-34-2-1: before 20 weeks, abortion is permitted only for serious health risk, to save the mother's life, or a lethal fetal anomaly.

passages.provision_quote: if: (A) the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest;
passages.note: Same enrolled bill text: during the first ten weeks, abortion is permitted when the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.

rows.reasoning: Senator Koch voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), which rewrote IC 16-34-2-1 so abortion is banned except, before 20 weeks, 'to prevent any serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save the pregnant woman's life' or for a lethal fetal anomaly, and, within the first ten weeks, when 'the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest.' This matches the rung text 'ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life,' and the annex confirms an early, tiered ban with all three exceptions still counts as this rung.
